title: Lekalo doctor, status, and readiness wire
description: Closed contract of the issue #92 readiness report family: `lekalo doctor`, `lekalo status`, and `lekalo readiness --phase PHASE`. One versioned document (lekalo/doctor/v1.0.0) whose checks are a closed vocabulary of read-only diagnostic states with closed next-action recipe ids. Doctor is read-only by default and forever; no secret, environment value, host identity, absolute path, or free-form text may appear. The doctor contract version is independent of the product release and of every Model/IR/graph/effect/lock/diagnostic contract version.

phase.description: The readiness phase; present only when report is `readiness`. `done` is an accepted CLI alias of `release` and never appears on the wire.

productVersion.description: The exact product version of the producing binary.

verdict.description: The derived verdict: blocked when a required check (or, for `doctor`, any check) is blocked or unknown; degraded when any check is not ok; ready otherwise. Missing optional evidence (for example HLV) degrades and is never a core failure.

checks.description: The closed check panel, sorted by id with no duplicates.

recipes.description: The safe-fix recipe preview of `lekalo doctor --fix`; advice only, never executed.

revisions.description: The exact git/model/lock revision facts; nothing more about the host.

commit.description: The exact HEAD commit identity (sha1 or sha256 spelling).

version.description: The exact canonical Model contract version.

state.description: fresh: the verifier accepts the committed lock; stale: a newer resolution exists; absent: no lock; invalid: the lock refused verification.
ok: nothing to report; degraded: actionable, non-blocking; blocked: a blocking condition; unknown: the check could not run because an upstream input was unavailable.

required.description: Whether the check is required by the selected report kind and phase.

reason.description: The closed distinguishing token (fresh/absent/stale, corrupt/missing, drift/clean, and so on).

nextAction.description: The closed safe-fix recipe id; present exactly when the state is not ok. Advice only.

diagnostics.description: Preserved registry rule ids of the underlying refusal, normalized and bounded.

notes.description: Closed informational tokens (platform facts, external-ref coverage); never a finding.

mutating.description: Whether the advice would mutate the project; doctor itself never mutates.
